logp.method_description: Solutions of Len-604 (100 μM, 5 mL) were prepared in n-octanol and combined with an equal volume of deionized water (5 mL) in a 15 mL centrifuge tube. The tube was wrapped in aluminum foil to protect the solution from light, shaken for 24 h in a thermostatic shaker incubator, and then allowed to settle until the two phases were completely separated. The oil and water distribution coefficient logPo/w was calculated using the relative concentrations of Len-604 in the two phases. (41,42) The minimum absorbance was set as 0.005. For absorbance below 0.005, it is used as <0.005 for logPo/w calculation. The error of logPo/w is ±0.01.
